legend: Vasya has written some permutation p1,p2,…,pn$$$p_1, p_2, \ldots, p_n$$$ of integers from 1$$$1$$$ to n$$$n$$$, so for all 1≤i≤n$$$1 \leq i \leq n$$$ it is true that 1≤pi≤n$$$1 \leq p_i \leq n$$$ and all p1,p2,…,pn$$$p_1, p_2, \ldots, p_n$$$ are different. After that he wrote n$$$n$$$ numbers next1,next2,…,nextn$$$next_1, next_2, \ldots, next_n$$$. The number nexti$$$next_i$$$ is equal to the minimal index i<j≤n$$$i  \lt  j \leq n$$$, such that pj>pi$$$p_j  \gt  p_i$$$. If there is no such j$$$j$$$ let's let's define as nexti=n+1$$$next_i = n + 1$$$.

In the evening Vasya went home from school and due to rain, his notebook got wet. Now it is impossible to read some written numbers. Permutation and some values nexti$$$next_i$$$ are completely lost! If for some i$$$i$$$ the value nexti$$$next_i$$$ is lost, let's say that nexti=−1$$$next_i = -1$$$.

You are given numbers next1,next2,…,nextn$$$next_1, next_2, \ldots, next_n$$$ (maybe some of them are equal to −1$$$-1$$$). Help Vasya to find such permutation p1,p2,…,pn$$$p_1, p_2, \ldots, p_n$$$ of integers from 1$$$1$$$ to n$$$n$$$, that he can write it to the notebook and all numbers nexti$$$next_i$$$, which are not equal to −1$$$-1$$$, will be correct.
input: The first line contains one integer t$$$t$$$ — the number of test cases (1≤t≤100000$$$1 \leq t \leq 100\,000$$$).

Next 2⋅t$$$2 \cdot t$$$ lines contains the description of test cases,two lines for each. The first line contains one integer n$$$n$$$ — the length of the permutation, written by Vasya (1≤n≤500000$$$1 \leq n \leq 500\,000$$$). The second line contains n$$$n$$$ integers next1,next2,…,nextn$$$next_1, next_2, \ldots, next_n$$$, separated by spaces (nexti=−1$$$next_i = -1$$$ or i<nexti≤n+1$$$i  \lt  next_i \leq n + 1$$$).
It is guaranteed, that the sum of n$$$n$$$ in all test cases doesn't exceed 500000$$$500\,000$$$.
In hacks you can only use one test case, so T=1$$$T = 1$$$.
output: Print T$$$T$$$ lines, in i$$$i$$$-th of them answer to the i$$$i$$$-th test case.
If there is no such permutations p1,p2,…,pn$$$p_1, p_2, \ldots, p_n$$$ of integers from 1$$$1$$$ to n$$$n$$$, that Vasya could write, print the only number −1$$$-1$$$.

In the other case print n$$$n$$$ different integers p1,p2,…,pn$$$p_1, p_2, \ldots, p_n$$$, separated by spaces (1≤pi≤n$$$1 \leq p_i \leq n$$$). All defined values of nexti$$$next_i$$$ which are not equal to −1$$$-1$$$ should be computed correctly p1,p2,…,pn$$$p_1, p_2, \ldots, p_n$$$ using defenition given in the statement of the problem. If there exists more than one solution you can find any of them.
note: In the first test case for permutation p=[1,2,3]$$$p = [1, 2, 3]$$$ Vasya should write next=[2,3,4]$$$next = [2, 3, 4]$$$, because each number in permutation is less than next. It's easy to see, that it is the only satisfying permutation.
In the third test case, any permutation can be the answer because all numbers nexti$$$next_i$$$ are lost.
In the fourth test case, there is no satisfying permutation, so the answer is −1$$$-1$$$.

legend.ai: Vasya 写下了一个由 1$$$1$$$ 到 n$$$n$$$ 的整数构成的排列 p1、p2、…、pn$$$p_1, p_2, \ldots, p_n$$$，因此对于所有 1≤i≤n$$$1 \leq i \leq n$$$，都有 1≤pi≤n$$$1 \leq p_i \leq n$$$，且 p1、p2、…、pn$$$p_1, p_2, \ldots, p_n$$$ 两两不同。之后，他又写下了 n$$$n$$$ 个数 next1、next2、…、nextn$$$next_1, next_2, \ldots, next_n$$$。其中，nexti$$$next_i$$$ 等于满足 pj>pi$$$p_j  \gt  p_i$$$ 的最小下标 i<j≤n$$$i  \lt  j \leq n$$$。如果不存在这样的 j$$$j$$$，则定义 nexti=n+1$$$next_i = n + 1$$$。
晚上，Vasya放学回家时，因为下雨，他的笔记本被淋湿了。现在有些写下的数字无法辨认。排列和一些 nexti$$$next_i$$$ 的值完全丢失了！如果某个 i$$$i$$$ 对应的 nexti$$$next_i$$$ 值丢失了，我们就令 nexti=−1$$$next_i = -1$$$。

给定数值 next1,next2,…,nextn$$$next_1, next_2, \ldots, next_n$$$(其中一些可能等于 −1$$$-1$$$)。请帮助 Vasya 找到一个由 1$$$1$$$ 到 n$$$n$$$ 的整数构成的排列 p1,p2,…,pn$$$p_1, p_2, \ldots, p_n$$$，使得他可以把它写在笔记本上，并且所有不等于 −1$$$-1$$$ 的 nexti$$$next_i$$$ 都是正确的。

input.ai: 接下来的 2⋅t$$$2 \cdot t$$$ 行包含测试用例的描述，每个测试用例占两行。第一行包含一个整数 n$$$n$$$——Vasya 写下的排列长度(1≤n≤500000$$$1 \leq n \leq 500\,000$$$)。第二行包含 n$$$n$$$ 个由空格分隔的整数 next1,next2,…,nextn$$$next_1, next_2, \ldots, next_n$$$(nexti=−1$$$next_i = -1$$$ 或 i<nexti≤n+1$$$i  \lt  next_i \leq n + 1$$$)。
在 hack 数据中只能使用一个测试用例，因此 T=1$$$T = 1$$$。

output.ai: 输出 T$$$T$$$ 行，其中第 i$$$i$$$ 行是第 i$$$i$$$ 个测试用例的答案。
如果不存在 Vasya 可以写出的、由 1$$$1$$$ 到 n$$$n$$$ 的整数构成的排列 p1,p2,…,pn$$$p_1, p_2, \ldots, p_n$$$，则输出唯一的数字 −1$$$-1$$$。

否则，输出 n$$$n$$$ 个互不相同的整数 p1,p2,…,pn$$$p_1, p_2, \ldots, p_n$$$，用空格分隔(1≤pi≤n$$$1 \leq p_i \leq n$$$)。所有已定义且不等于 −1$$$-1$$$ 的 nexti$$$next_i$$$ 值，都应根据题面中给出的定义，使用 p1,p2,…,pn$$$p_1, p_2, \ldots, p_n$$$ 正确计算。如果存在多个解，你可以输出其中任意一个。

note.ai: 在第一个测试用例中，对于排列 p=[1,2,3]$$$p = [1, 2, 3]$$$，Vasya 应写出 next=[2,3,4]$$$next = [2, 3, 4]$$$，因为排列中的每个数字都小于 next。很容易看出，这是唯一满足条件的排列。

在第四个测试用例中，不存在满足条件的排列，因此答案为 −1$$$-1$$$。
